tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Prove a crypto payment landed at the expected recipient (the x402 close-loop). chain: ETH or SOL for native transfers; ETH + token for an ERC-20 (e.g. USDC). Pass the tx hash, the expected recipient address, and the minimum amount in human units.

token.description: ERC-20 contract address (ETH only). Omit for native ETH/SOL.

expected_to.description: Address that must have received the payment.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount accepted, in human units (e.g. 0.5 for USDC).

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Read native + ERC-20 balances for any address. chain: ETH or SOL. For an ERC-20 on ETH, pass the token contract to get its symbol and human balance.

token.description: ERC-20 contract (ETH only). Omit for native balance.

tools.name: token_info
tools.description: Resolve ERC-20 token metadata (symbol, name, decimals) from a contract address — so an agent can label and price a token it has never seen.

tools.name: decode_transaction
tools.description: Decode an Ethereum transaction: from, to, value (ETH) and the ERC-20 transfer (token, symbol, amount) if one occurred. Lets an agent understand a payment without a block explorer.

tools.name: resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name to its Ethereum address (e.g. vitalik.eth), or reverse-resolve an address to its primary ENS name. Useful when a payment request arrives as a human-readable name.

tools.name: chain_status
tools.description: Latest block height (ETH) or slot (SOL) — a quick liveness check so an agent can confirm the chain is synced before acting on it.

tools.name: token_price
tools.description: Spot USD price of a token via a Chainlink price feed (no API key). symbol: ETH/BTC/USDC/SOL, or pass a custom feed address.

tools.name: transaction_history
tools.description: PREMIUM: recent transactions for an Ethereum address (the indexer view free RPCs can't give you). Costs 0.001 ETH / 0.01 SOL / 0.5 USDC — pay our address first, then call again with payment_chain + payment_txhash. Our ETH: 0xc62b0aCba58E2Fc31cE2d27721Ee51154a808f52  SOL: D19x8rMGo9dCv98UGaNuv6SM2Xov8Q5TxCkjrmfeynmn

address.description: Ethereum address to list transactions for.

payment_chain.description: Chain the payment was made on.

payment_txhash.description: Tx hash of your payment to our address.
